about: Bink's handle (HBINK points at it), in bink2w64.dll; public fields from Bink's header, private ones read from its code and live

evidence.says: live on a game clip: +0x12C (0 at open, sound tracks opened) and +0x40 written 1 turn on BinkShouldSkip; +0x630 counts decoded frames (skipped ones too); +0x644 written 0 restarts the clock; +0x1B8 points at one 0x1C0 track struct even with no track, not zeroed (+0x60, +0x1A0, +0x5C hold leftovers), its +0x4C the 16.16 speed scale
